items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 97:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the river that comes out of Eden? The Bina that was included in the Hochma of AA at the time of their coming out in the place of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, and afterward at the time of birth the Reisha de Lo It Yeda became clothed in the Malchut of the second restriction, through which the Chochma Stima'ah of AA was also corrected in the Nukva and took the Bina out to the aspect of the throat and the body. Behold, this Bina that is in the throat is discerned as a river that comes out of Eden, for Eden is the Mocha Stima'ah, and the Bina that was included in it comes out from it to the aspect of his body. However, this coming out of the Bina of AA is not felt in the GAR of Bina, namely from the chest of AA and above, where the upper Aba and Ima stand, but only from the chest and below, where YESHSUT stand, which are the aspect of the ZAT of Bina. For in the GAR of Bina, which are in the secret of "for He delights in mercy," there is no place for any screen and restriction to affect it, for the restriction was only on the aspect of Hochma and not on the aspect of Hassadim, as is known. But in the NHY of Aba and Ima, and likewise in YESHSUT, which are the aspect of the ZAT that need the illumination of Hochma, and cannot receive while they are in the aspect of a body, therefore the aspect of the diminution of the river that comes out of Eden rides upon them, and they alone are discerned as coming out of Eden and being diminished by the Nukva with which the Mocha Stima'ah was corrected, being lacking from the aspect of their attributed illumination. And this is the secret of the first He of the Name HaVaYaH, whose corner is the Yod, and the aspect of Israel Saba, which spreads here and there and becomes a Dalet. See below in Answer 98.
